title: 第19章 九转赤火草第20章 太古祖龙
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 天老对叶辰这种越战越勇的意志可谓是无比的欣赏，但现在的问题是怎么进入秘境中，现在秘境外可是闻名上界的六十四帝卫啊，不是一般人可以进入的
“天老，那我们现在怎么进入秘境当中呢？”
叶辰看着在思考的天老道，内心对这次的造化更加渴望，毕竟刚刚可是夸下海口说要组建自己的帝卫了
“有了，我用灵魂力要掩盖你的气息，这样我们就找机会乘机进入秘境中”
天老啪着脑袋道，死者的灵魂一般人是察觉不到的，就算是六十四帝卫也一样
“那太好了，那天老你赶紧来吧”
叶辰高兴的看着天老道，只要能进入秘境中，不管是什么办法都可以
“好，到时候，你找准时机冲进秘境中”
说完天老将自身的灵魂逐渐的淡化，形成一个无色膜，覆盖上叶辰的身上
“太好了，这下我就可以进入秘境中的”
叶辰高兴的看着掩盖自己无色膜道
“小辰子，这个我可坚持不了多久，你一但找到机会就立马冲进去，不然我们就再也没有机会了”
天老的声音传入叶辰的耳朵道
“好的”
叶辰也不再惊叹，而是转身看向秘境外的凌浩等人，找着冲进秘境的时机
此时真武大陆太初域的一处虚空上出现山出现一道空间裂缝
随着空间裂缝不断扩大，产生的空间气流席卷整片天空，整个虚空都在剧烈的颤抖，而后七八道黑色的身影从空间裂缝中冲出来
类似的空间裂缝在真武大陆各大域都出现灵域，妖域，荒域，武域上空都出现百丈空间裂缝，从空间裂缝中不断的有黑色的身影冲出，使各大域的势力开始密切关注这凭空出现的空间裂缝
此时真龙秘境外
帝一与帝二突然看向远方，察觉到了真武大陆各大域上出现的空间裂缝，并且有许多金仙以上强者的气息，甚至还有准仙圣境界的强者
“神子，上界的各大势力好像也降临了这片大陆”
帝一来到凌浩身旁恭敬的道
“哦，行，我知道了”
凌浩对于上界的势力来到真武大陆并不意外，毕竟这是暗杀凌浩最好的机会，所以上界的一些势力也肯定会派杀手来暗杀凌浩
“我们先不用管他们，我们不去找他们，他们也会自己来找我们的，我们现在就先进入秘境吧”
随后凌浩坐在白泽的背上笑着道，对于这些势力的暗杀凌浩也是早有预感，毕竟前世也是来下界历练的时候也出现过
前世凌浩刚满十五岁时，就带着六十四帝卫来到下界历练，而上界的各大势力纷纷都派出杀手来暗杀凌浩，最后被六十四帝卫灭杀并覆灭背后的势力，而六十四帝卫死了一个成了六十三帝卫
“这一世，我不会再犯同样的错误”
凌浩眼神中充满着无穷的杀意道，于是走进秘境中，并不理会秘境外的叶辰，待事后就是叶辰的死期
凌浩也知道就算他们一直堵在秘境入口，叶辰也会有机会进入秘境中寻找秘境里的造化，而现在当务之急就是提前叶辰找到秘境中的那个造化机缘
随着凌浩等人走进秘境中，叶辰也乘机冲进秘境中，而随后着真武大陆上的各宗门长老也陆陆续续的进入秘境中
真龙秘境中，宛如仙境一般，步入眼帘的是清澈见底的河流，各种高阶灵草更是数不胜数，各种灵异妖兽狂奔
content_en:
God admires Ye Chen's will to become more courageous as he fights, but the problem now is how to enter the secret realm. Outside the secret realm are the 64 Imperial Guards who are famous in the upper world. They are not accessible to ordinary people.
"God, how do we enter the secret realm now?"
Ye Chen looked at Tian Laodao who was thinking, and his heart was even more eager for this blessing. After all, he just boasted about forming his own Imperial Guard in Haikou.
"Yes, I will use my soul power to cover up your aura, so that we can find an opportunity to enter the secret realm."
Tianlao slapped his head and said, most people cannot detect the soul of the deceased, even the 64th Imperial Guard.
"That's great, please hurry up and come that day."
Ye Chen looked at Tian Laodao happily, as long as he could enter the secret realm, no matter what method he used, he would do it
"Okay, when the time comes, find the right time to rush into the secret realm."
After saying this, Tianlao gradually faded his soul, forming a colorless film that covered Ye Chen's body.
"Great, now I can enter the secret realm."
Ye Chen happily looked at the colorless film covering his face and said
"Xiao Chenzi, I can't hold on to this for long. As soon as you find an opportunity, rush in immediately, otherwise we will never have a chance again."
Tianlao's voice reached Ye Chen's ears:
"Okay"
Ye Chen no longer marveled, but turned to look at Ling Hao and others outside the secret realm, looking for an opportunity to rush into the secret realm.
At this time, a mountain appeared in the void in the Taichu region of Zhenwu Continent, and a spatial crack appeared.
As the space cracks continued to expand, the resulting space airflow swept across the entire sky. The entire void was trembling violently, and then seven or eight black figures rushed out from the space cracks.
Similar space cracks have appeared in all the major regions of the Zhenwu Continent. Hundred-foot space cracks have appeared in the sky above the Spirit Realm, Monster Realm, Desolate Realm, and Martial Realm. Black figures are constantly rushing out from the space cracks, causing the forces in the major regions to pay close attention to the space cracks that appear out of thin air.
At this time, outside the secret realm of the True Dragon
"Yeah!"
Di Yi and Di Er suddenly looked into the distance and noticed the space cracks appearing in the major areas of the Zhenwu Continent, and there were many auras of powerful people above the Golden Immortal level, and even powerful people in the quasi-immortal saint realm.
"Son of God, it seems that the major forces in the upper world have also descended on this continent."
When Di Yi came to Ling Hao's side, he said respectfully
"Oh, okay, I get it"
Ling Hao was not surprised that the forces from the upper world came to Zhenwu Continent. After all, this was the best opportunity to assassinate Ling Hao, so some forces from the upper world would definitely send assassins to assassinate Ling Hao.
"We don't need to worry about them now. If we don't look for them, they will come to us on their own. Let's enter the secret realm now."
Then Ling Hao sat on Bai Ze's back and said with a smile, Ling Hao had already had a premonition of the assassination by these forces. After all, it had happened in his previous life when he came to the lower world for training.
In his previous life, when Ling Hao had just turned fifteen, he took the Sixty-Four Imperial Guards to the lower realm for training. The major forces in the upper realm sent assassins to assassinate Ling Hao. In the end, the Sixty-Four Imperial Guards killed him and wiped out the forces behind him. One of the Sixty-Four Imperial Guards died and became the Sixty-Third Imperial Guards.
"In this life, I will not make the same mistake again."
Ling Hao's eyes were filled with endless killing intent, so he walked into the secret realm and ignored Ye Chen outside the secret realm. Afterwards, Ye Chen would die.
Ling Hao also knew that even if they were blocked at the entrance to the secret realm, Ye Chen would have the opportunity to enter the secret realm to find the good fortune in the secret realm. The top priority now was to find the good fortune in the secret realm in advance for Ye Chen.
As Ling Hao and others entered the secret realm, Ye Chen also took the opportunity to rush into the secret realm, and then the elders of various sects on Zhenwu Continent also entered the secret realm one after another.
The True Dragon Secret Realm is like a fairyland. What you see when you step into the eyes is a crystal clear river, countless high-level spiritual grasses, and all kinds of supernatural monsters running wildly.
